title: No test proves that a request under hot reload makes no `stat` call.
text: `rule:config/an-edit-reaches-the-next-request-without-a-restart` says no request looks at the file: the background check makes one `stat` per configuration file per interval (`crates/nvs-cli/src/reload.rs:80-82`). `revalidation_is_lazy_and_rate_capped` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/script.rs:3202`) checks what a resolve returns, and does not count `stat` calls. Closing it means a test that serves many requests between two checks and counts the file-system calls they made.
